title: Van Flandern alerts Harrington to Pioneer 10 data on a planet beyond the Kuiper belt
place_text: US Naval Observatory; outer solar system

tellings.quote: he calls up Robert Harton he's like hey Robert you gotta check out this data from Pioneer 10

plain: A researcher named Matt LaCroix says that in the 1980s an astronomer named Thomas Van Flandern called a colleague, Robert Harrington, at the US Naval Observatory and told him he had to look at data from Pioneer 10, a space probe sent to the far reaches of the solar system. According to LaCroix, the data hinted at an unknown planet beyond the Kuiper belt, the ring of icy bodies past Neptune. If true, it would mean a large hidden planet sits at the edge of our solar system.
